_doc: Cable centerlines in the robot frame (mm, x forward, y left, z up). Torso and head entries come from A* searches on 1 mm occupancy grids of the current CAD (OpenRB removed from the head); ttl-* neck entries are the middle-conductor control points of head-neck-local-20261009/routes.json. Generated by guide/content/collect_routes (session scratch); edit here. bundle_neck: torso top-rear exit -> outside behind the neck -> outside mouth of the cap notch (exterior A*, 3 mm clearance, nominal joint pose). bundle_head: notch -> inside the closed head -> Pi header pins (interior A*, 3 mm clearance, rebuilt notched cap). Both from scratchpad print-work/cap/work/route-*.json, 2026-10-09. V1.7 cap (Pi 4.6 mm further back): bundle_head tail from interference-audit/verify-cap reroute (over the Pi top edge); head_i2s re-routed around the +y board edge between the moved rail and the cap rib at x 53 (>= 1.0 mm to the cap, 1.8 mm to the Pi); head_csi Pi end moved with the Pi. V1.8 head (camera turned 180 deg, connector on the -y side; Pi 1 mm higher): head_csi re-drawn from the camera connector exit (76.5, -9.6, 131) along the right-hand side of the head to the Pi CSI connector at the -y end of the Pi, hand-set and verified with interference-audit/cables.py. bundle_head tail raised 1.25 mm over the Pi top edge (crossing centreline z 146.0; Pi top 144.6, cap roof underside about 150 there, Pi rails start at y 26.5). 2026-10-12: torso routes rewritten for the V1.8 rear pack (OpenRB upright in the pack, DFR1202 behind it, J in its pocket, BNO085 on the plate front); every cable that leaves the pack crosses the plate through its top notch. routes-pre-pack-20261012.json keeps the old torso routes. 2026-10-12 (later): star junction J and the three link splices removed; the servos take power through the OpenRB ports. openrbpwr (20 AWG) and trunk (22 AWG) now start at the DFR1202 5V/GND pads (-41, 4.5, -4) and drop to z -13 in the old J corner before following their previous lane paths; vout and feed_r/l/n deleted. ttl-05-04 ... ttl-07-06 (leg chains) are written by guide/content/leg_routes.py: thigh and ankle links are the middle conductors of the 2026-10-09 leg routes; the two hip links run through the torso base centre slot (2026-10-12, rear pack fills the old coil pocket). 2026-10-13 V1.9 (print/ext-v19/route-v19.json): the neck bundle leaves the pack notch, crosses the torso top to the -y side, runs through the torso clip (under S12-horn-025), up the neck to the bracket clip (under S11-horn-040), enters the head through the -y side of the lower shell floor opening, crosses the jaw-support wall, drops through the head clip (under H-jaw_support-03) and out of its window, passes under the amplifier housings behind the Pi, through the cap clip (under E-pi-04) over the Pi top edge and down the Pi front to the gather point at (77, 27.5, 115.5); bundle_neck = route points 0-9, bundle_head = points 9-32. The cap notch route, head_i2s and head_spk are removed. pi_trunk, imu and uart are the full guide-cable centrelines (each keeps its V1.8 torso path to the pack notch, then the bundle and its own fan wire to Pi pin 2, 3 or 8); the former trunk and uart_lower keys are their torso prefixes. audio_* are the five amplifier jumpers (ground on Pi pin 34) and the two speaker leads; fan_pin_NN are the single-wire fans from the gather point to each bundle pin (record only; the guide draws one tube per cable). 2026-10-13 USB-C 5 V (bringup/build/power-diagram/README.md): the DFR1202, XT30 and 12 V tether are gone. vin20, tether and openrbpwr are replaced by supply (22 AWG solid pair from the Adafruit 5991 on the bench): it leaves the model below the pack floor opening (x -42, y 0, z -44), climbs the +Y side of the empty converter channel behind the R/L link plugs into the old lower +Y corner and follows the old openrbpwr points from z -13.8 under the lane entrance and up the lane to the OpenRB terminal block J4 (-29, 1.5, 27.5). pi_trunk (the two Pi jumper chains clamped under the J4 screws) now starts at that terminal point and joins its old path at (-26.8, 2, 36.2). 2026-10-14 layout F rear converter box, V1.15 build (print/back-plate/layout-F/: XL4015 IN ends and the 5991 terminal at -y, XL4015 OUT ends and the 5991 USB-C at +y; solid front plate, no passage P1; wire notch A at the top-wall front edge and notch B in the cover-plate top edge over y 3.2..12.4). pw-15v (5991 screw terminal, straight out of the -y window of the bottom tier, up the outside of the -y wall, in through the -y window of the middle board into XL4015 #2 (5 V) IN) and pw-15v-link (#2 IN, out of the same window, up the outside of the -y wall, in through the -y window of the top board into XL4015 #1 (7 V) IN): the 15V_feed_p and 15V_link_p wires of layout-F/wires_F.json. pw-7v (#1 OUT straight out of the +y window of the top board, up the outside of the +y wall at |y| 34.5 in column x -63.3, across the box top at z 45 in lane y 4.4, down through notch A into the box front cavity at x -47.8, forward under the shell lip at z 30 through notch B onto the cover lip and up to the J4 wire entries (-31.5, 0, 25.4); the 7V_a wire with its last point centred on J4) and pi-lead (#2 OUT out of the +y window of the middle board, up the outside of the +y wall in column x -47.8, across the top in lane y 10.7, through notch A and notch B, up the front of the roof rib to the pack notch and the bundle point (-6, -14, 43.5), then the former pi_trunk path through the neck clips to Pi pins 2/6; the 5V_b wire plus that tail). Per-wire lengths, cut lengths and the notch record are in powerWiresF; the gate cable check (interference-audit/cables.py) samples these centrelines against every audit solid, rear_frame included. The 2026-10-14 USB-C data cable keeps the pack floor slot (not drawn). supply and pi_trunk moved to retired. 2026-10-15 Radxa Cubie A7Z head (print/a7z-head/, print/face-a7z/): the A7Z sits where the Pi sat, but the 32 mm Radxa Camera 13M 214 board covers the edge-row socket ends of pins 10 to 34 (0.3 mm), so plugs there cannot exit. uart now ends on inner-row pin 7 (UART2 TX; pin 11 RX beside it), leaving under the camera bottom edge; audio_amp_gnd_pin39 replaces audio_alt_gnd_pin34 (amplifier ground on inner-row pin 39); audio_amp_bclk_pin12 ends at the tip of a short single female socket on pin 12 (9.5 mm instead of the 14.25 mm Dupont housing) and turns up behind the camera. imu still ends on pin 3 (TWI7 SDA). head_csi is unused: the camera ribbon is drawn as parts (camera_board stub and camera_ribbon). 2026-10-15 A7Z gate fix: the five amplifier wires cross the board top edge 0.4 mm higher (z 146.6 and 147.7) to clear the A7Z PCIe FPC socket, and the LRC and DIN wires come down 1.8 mm further forward (x 66.6) to clear the USB-C OTG socket. 2026-10-15 later: pin 12 BCLK is an ordinary Dupont plug (Shawn: it fits); its wire comes down in the gap between the plug end and the bare camera back (x 75.3, y 11.2, clear of the lower +Y camera screw head) into the plug end. touch_pad_* and touch_a7z_pin*: touch extension wires, A* on the 1 mm head grid inside the closed cap above its rim, from extension-20261015-touch/build_touch_geometry.py (regenerate there, do not edit here).

source.astar: scratchpad scene/findpath2.py on occ.npy (torso, lo [-95,-40,-62]) and occ_head.npy (head, lo [-70,-55,40]), 1 mm voxels
source.v19: guide/print/ext-v19/route-v19.json (neck-bundle-v19, 33 points, group radius 1.7 mm, inference; single wires 0.65 mm)
source.ampWired: 2026-10-13: the five audio wires are soldered into the amplifier (no header or jumper housings). Each audio_amp_* route now starts at its hole on the board front (x 38.76, z 140.5), lies flat to the board edge and rises to the old housing axis at x 42.4; every new point lies inside the removed right-angle header and housing envelope (print/amp-wired/make_amp_wired.py).

retired._doc: 2026-10-14: centrelines no longer drawn. supply (7 V pair from the pack floor opening to J4) and pi_trunk (Pi lead from the J4 screws to the Pi) are replaced by pw-7v and pi-lead from the rear converter box; pi-lead reuses pi_trunk from (-29, 1.5, 27.5) on.

powerWiresF._doc: Layout F (approved 2026-10-14; P1 deleted and the top notch added 2026-10-14 evening) power wires, per wire. Every wire leaves its terminal straight out of its side window and stays outside the box. 15 V link and feed run window to window outside the -y wall. The 7 V pair and the Pi 5 V pair climb the outside of the +y wall, cross the box top, drop through the notch in the top-wall front edge into the box front cavity, pass under the shell lip through the notch in the cover-plate top edge and ride on the cover lip into the pack; 7 V to J4, 5 V up through the head notch to the neck bundle. boxMm: path length in wires_F.json from the terminal entry to the other terminal (15 V), to J4 (7 V) or to the bundle point (-6, -14, 43.5) (5 V). beyondBoxMm: the pi-lead beyond the bundle point (bundle path to the Pi header). cutMm per pair: the longer wire of the pair + 15 mm per screw-terminal end, rounded up to 5 mm, both wires cut alike. Pi lead: + 15 mm at the XL4015 end + 45 mm neck slack and dressing (39 mm worst neck and head pose, route-v19-motion.json). Net p = red (+), q = black (-); 7V_a/5V_b and 15V_feed_p sit at the lower screw, which is + on every terminal.

notch.A: top-wall front edge x -49.8..-47.0, through z 41.8..43, inner corners r 1.0
notch.B: cover-plate top edge x -47..-45, floor z 28.5 (cover-lip top), corners r 0.5
